title: +GENERAL CHEMISTRY
description: Introduces students to the fundamentals of chemistry and the practice of science. Covers atomic structure and the periodic table, including the biological and terrestrial abundance of the elements, chemical bonding and molecular structure, and the transformations of substances through chemical reactions, including how these transformations contribute to climate change.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Evening midterms Thursdays 2030-2150. Schedule conflicts are not allowed without written permission of the instructor.
